icon.$description: Glyph sizes. A distinct semantic axis from spacing — it tracks optical weight, not layout rhythm — so it gets its own group even though every rung aliases the spacing scale. That indirection is what makes a future "larger glyphs under a coarse pointer" pass a five-line change instead of a hunt through .vue files.

container.$description: Widths of floating surfaces (menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs, toasts). Named `size.container.*` and NOT emitted as `--container-*` on purpose: `--container-*` is a Tailwind v4 theme namespace, so using it would silently redefine Tailwind's own container scale and change every max-w-sm / max-w-lg in the system. Until this group existed, three of these five widths were owned by Tailwind's defaults rather than by us.

md.$description: Toast viewport. The one off-ladder value (the others are 10/18/20/32rem); squaring it to 26 or 28rem is a visual change and belongs in its own commit.
